policy.causal_rule: Do not convert co-occurrence, issuer announcements, stablecoin gross volume, account ratios, or model-derived liquidation maps into XRP price causality without independently verified flows and out-of-sample evidence.

edges.claim: Liqwall reports XRP near $1.29, $1.41B aggregate OI, positive funding and mostly long liquidations at 12:32 UTC; panel methodology and universe require verification.
TradRadar reports XRP near $1.2894, $2.00B OI across seven exchanges, positive funding and long-skewed account ratios at 13:00 UTC; its universe differs from Liqwall.

Tokyo SBIC East Japan identifies itself as an SME investment-development company with regional public, chamber, financial-institution and corporate shareholders. The reviewed profile does not establish an affiliation with SBI Holdings; the similar acronym is not proof of a relationship.

SBI Ripple Asia announced technical support for startups contemplating XRPL use. This establishes an XRPL-related activity for SBI Ripple Asia, not for the distinct SBIC East Japan entity and not a measured XRP flow.
PR #1338 proposes strict schema, numeric, label, timestamp and relevance-weight validation and explicit NOT_ISSUED metadata; it is draft and unmerged, so main remains unchanged.
Main's current artifact has score 44, confidence 0.0 and provider failures. It cannot support a directional forecast.
The paper state has position_product=null; despite the workflow's BTC-USD configured product, the persisted position identity is unknown and must not be silently assigned.

Fresh-main PR #1338 head db619067a612904f6428bf0ad5dbaedda76d3347 passed core CI (298 tests plus 8 subtests in 10.05 seconds) and the fail-closed gate. It remains draft/unmerged, so main is unchanged.
PR #1339 removes exactly one identified data-only graph file from a branch based on current main; the durable copy remains on the dedicated research branch. It is draft/unmerged.
The inspected core CI workflow is configured for pull requests targeting main. At capture, no CI run was returned for PR #1339; this is a visibility/status limitation, not a failure result.
The inspected fail-closed gate triggers on pull_request opened/synchronize/reopened/ready_for_review. At capture, no gate run was returned for PR #1339; execution remains unverified.

Fresh-main cleanup PR #1339 passed exact-head CI (294 tests plus 8 subtests in 7.72 seconds) and the fail-closed gate. It remains draft/unmerged; main still contains the file until approval and merge.
PR #1340 replaces the stale mixed/positive narrative with explicit NOT_ISSUED text and removes the stale audio reference; it is draft/unmerged and does not restore automatic publishing.

A public video argues for moving long-term XRP holdings off exchanges and using a brokerage model for execution/slippage considerations. This is not independent proof of price impact, exchange outflows or superior execution for all users.

A public video proposes oil disruption → yen carry unwind → global liquidity shock → XRP infrastructure relevance. Treat as a competing causal hypothesis; require synchronized macro, FX, rates, crypto flows and falsifiable event-window tests.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Positive funding, high long-account shares and mostly long liquidations may indicate vulnerability to further downside if leveraged longs continue to unwind.
disconfirming_evidence: Account ratios are not notional exposure.
Open-interest aggregates differ by about $590M between dashboards.
Open interest may represent hedged exposure and liquidation feeds are incomplete.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The Japanese 'SBIC' phrase may refer to Tokyo SBIC East Japan or one of its regional sister companies, but the intended referent cannot be resolved without original context.
disconfirming_evidence: SBIC is also used for other organizations and datasets.
No reviewed evidence connects this entity directly to XRP or SBI Holdings.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Merging and regenerating with the strict emitter should prevent malformed provider responses from becoming fabricated neutral confidence and make the lack of a calibrated price model explicit.
disconfirming_evidence: The PR remains draft/unmerged; current main output remains unchanged.
Passing tests establish the implemented guards, not out-of-sample predictive performance.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Merging a fresh-main one-file cleanup PR would restore the main tree by removing the unintended research-only graph artifact without touching runtime code.
disconfirming_evidence: The PR remains draft and unmerged; main still contains the file until approval.
CI and gate passing verify the branch, not that main has been restored.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Updating the tracked static summary to NOT_ISSUED would remove a misleading directional impression while preserving read-only artifact generation and human approval boundaries.
disconfirming_evidence: PR #1340 is draft/unmerged and current main remains stale until approval.
Core CI was still running at capture.

competing_hypotheses.claim: A major oil shock could pressure yen-funded carry positions, tighten global liquidity and indirectly affect XRP through broad risk appetite and liquidity transmission.
disconfirming_evidence: The video is not independent evidence of current positioning or causality.
No synchronized event study or XRP-specific net-flow attribution has been performed.
A broad risk-off shock could depress XRP without increasing XRP utility or demand.
